descriptionChirho: The personal name of Joseph the Levite from Cyprus, surnamed Barnabas ('son of encouragement') by the apostles, who became a prominent early church leader and missionary companion of Paul. All 28 occurrences across nominative, accusative, genitive, and dative singular forms refer to the same individual; the two clusters reflect only minor orthographic/morphological variants in translation, not distinct senses. Multilingual evidence is uniform: spa 'Barnabâs / Barnábas,' hin 'बरनबास / बरनबस,' arb 'بَرنابا / بَرْنَابَا,' kor '바나바,' swa 'Barnaba.' Attested throughout Acts 4:36-15:39 and Paul's epistles (1 Cor 9:6, Gal 2:1-13, Col 4:10).
